build_match_cost: build a Match Cost instance from a config dict using the MATCH_COST registry
build_assigner: build a mask assigner instance from a config dict using the MASK_ASSIGNERS registry
build_transformer: build a Transformer instance from a config dict using the TRANSFORMER registry
review_TRANSFORMER_registry: review the TRANSFORMER Registry used to register and build Transformer modules
review_MASK_ASSIGNERS_registry: review the MASK_ASSIGNERS Registry used to register and build mask assigner modules
